binary.note: GeoArrow-style: county i owns polygons [cPO[i], cPO[i+1]); polygon p owns rings [pRO[p], pRO[p+1]) (first = exterior, CCW; rest = holes, CW); ring r owns vertices [rO[r], rO[r+1]). Rings are closed (first vertex repeated). Adjacent counties share identical vertices (queen/rook contiguity can be built by exact vertex match).

properties.order: sorted by 5-digit FIPS; every other county dataset (us-elections, us-county-mortality) is aligned to this order
properties.names: names.json holds fips/name/state arrays in the same order
properties.coverage: Contiguous US + DC (3109 counties). Alaska, Hawaii and territories dropped.
properties.boundaries: Census cartographic boundary file cb_2022_us_county_20m (1:20,000,000), coordinates rounded to 5 decimals
properties.connecticut: Connecticut appears as its 9 planning regions (2022 Census vintage; SVI 2022, PLACES and ERS use them). MIT election returns are reported for the 8 legacy counties, so us-elections columns are NaN for CT.
properties.missingIncomePerCapita: ACS per-capita income needs a Census API key; medianHouseholdIncome (SAIPE 2022) shipped instead.

storyNotes: Age-adjusted diabetes prevalence (CDC PLACES 2024, BRFSS 2022) is strongly clustered: global Moran's I = 0.70 on queen contiguity. 249 high-high LISA counties (p<0.01), concentrated in TX (62), MS (50), LA (28), GA (27), AL (25), AR (23) - the Deep South / Black Belt / Appalachian 'diabetes belt'.
Diabetes range: 6.0% to 21.5% (max: Dimmit, TX); 408 low-low counties, led by CO (45), MT (43), WI (41), MN (38), NY (35), SD (30).
Median household income 2022 ranges $28,972 (McDowell, WV) to $167,605 (Loudoun, VA); Moran's I = 0.61.
Diabetes vs median household income correlation r = -0.60 across counties: a good candidate for OLS residual maps, spatial lag/error and GWR (coefficient varies by region).
Minority share is as spatially clustered as diabetes (Moran's I = 0.70): Black Belt, Texas-border and Native American reservation counties stand out; most populous county Los Angeles, CA (9,936,690).
Rural-urban continuum: 1180 metro counties (codes 1-3) and 1929 nonmetro; mean diabetes prevalence 10.8% metro vs 11.4% nonmetro.
Contiguity: 9,102 queen edges, mean 5.9 neighbours, max 14; 2 true islands (Nantucket MA, San Juan WA) have no neighbours - exercise the island handling of weights.
Connecticut appears as 9 planning regions (2022 vintage); Alaska and Hawaii dropped (3,109 contiguous counties + DC).
